definitions.WHOLE_FILE_READ_SELECTED_BOUNDARIES: Entire file read; only listed boundary judgments supported. Not exhaustive semantic review or a clean verdict.

definitions.NO_RECORDED_BOUNDARY_REVIEW: This audit has no recorded boundary judgment for this file. Prior historical audits and passing tests do not upgrade it.

scope: Conservative coverage of THIS three-pass audit; production source only. Tests, documents and generated artifacts are accounted for separately. No full-repository completion claim.
